frames.source: episodes/r8_rep (r8_rep/rep_record.py): reference-bot set_lamp episodes recorded with a separate warm 224x224 head-camera renderer (record.py conventions; recorder check in results/r8/probes/record_check.json)
frames.fit_episodes: index rows without error, task set_lamp, configs train-0000..0269, k=8 (clean bot) and k=9 (noisy bot, R6 noise settings), complete when the probe set is built (count written to probeset.json)
frames.test_episodes: index rows without error, task set_lamp, configs train-0270..0299 (held out from all R8 training), k=8, 10 (clean) and 9, 11 (noisy)
frames.64px_rows: the stored-style 96 px frame of the same tick (interface 128 px render, box to 96), box-resized to 64 px exactly as R6's probes did

labels_simulator_truth_labels_only.lamp: frames with >= 16 visible lamp pixels at 224 px (segmentation render); label = lamp on (truth); up to 12 frames per episode, rng seed 0
labels_simulator_truth_labels_only.plate_in_view: positive: >= 16 visible plate pixels; negative: 0 plate pixels and 0 pixels of its dark frame; 1-15 px excluded; up to 6 positive + 6 negative per episode, rng seed 1
labels_simulator_truth_labels_only.plate_bearing: frames with >= 16 visible plate pixels; target = horizontal-plane bearing of the plate centre from the camera's optical axis (rad, + = left); up to 8 per episode, rng seed 2
labels_simulator_truth_labels_only.difference_from_R6: R6 labelled the lamp by the bot's fresh sightings and the plate by the bot's confirmed button track (sensors-only beliefs) on M5 demo frames; R8 uses simulator truth (pixel counts from a segmentation render), so the R8 numbers are on a different, cleaner label set and are not identical to R6's

arms.vjepa21_l: V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L/16 distilled (dgrauet/vjepa-2.1-vitl-mlx), 224 px image path, MLX port
arms.lewm_tworooms, lewm_pusht, lewm_cube, le: official LeWM checkpoint encoders, zero-shot, 224 px, MLX port
arms.random_vit: LeWM encoder architecture (ViT-tiny/14, 224 px) at HF random init, seed 0, never trained (control)
arms.r6_bars_recomputed_on_these_frames: P2-A' s0 encoder (runs/p2_a2/ckpt_016000) on 64 px; R6 LeWM (runs/lewm_s1/final) and R6 random-encoder control (runs/lewm_rand/final) on 64 px; a supervised 64 px CNN (R6/P2 architecture, p2_lamp_probe.py: 4 convs, Adam 1e-3, 1500 steps x batch 128, seed 0) trained on the fit frames per task

features.global (primary): final normalised tokens: [CLS ; mean of patch tokens] for DINOv2, LeWM checkpoints and random_vit; mean of patch tokens for V-JEPA (no CLS); P2-A' / R6 LeWM / R6 random: their 192-d embedding as in R6 (lewm/probes.py featurizer)
features.lewm_projected (reported): for the LeWM checkpoints: the 192-d projector output (the LeWM latent; = R6's 'lewm' row definition), BatchNorm in eval mode
features.grid (secondary): patch-token grid average-pooled 2x2 (DINOv2 / LeWM / random_vit 16x16 -> 8x8, V-JEPA 14x14 -> 7x7), plus CLS when present

probes.linear (primary): standardised features (fit-set mean/std), linear softmax, Adam 1e-2 x 800 full-batch steps, L2 1e-3 on the weight = R6 lewm/probes.py; bearing: same optimiser, linear regression on the standardised target (MSE), L2 1e-3
probes.attentive (secondary): standardised grid tokens; one learned query, keys/values Linear(d -> 64), softmax pooling, Linear head; AdamW 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4, 600 full-batch steps, seed 0
probes.cnn: as above, 64 px, one net per task (2-way head for lamp / plate, 1 output with MSE on the standardised bearing)

metrics: lamp: test accuracy (headline) and AUC; plate in view: test AUC (headline) and accuracy; bearing: test mean absolute error in degrees (headline) against the constant fit-mean baseline. Test = held-out configs 0270-0299 only.
reading: No pass/fail gate: a bake-off. An encoder 'reads the lamp' if its primary linear lamp probe is >= 0.90 (R6's G4 bar). The LeWM checkpoint for the checkpoint-vs-scratch arm is picked by the rule in results/r8/lewm_ckpt/protocol.json from these numbers.
